items.text: Cosponsored a bill to enroll every resident in a single public health plan covering medical, dental, vision, hearing, mental health, and long-term care, with no premiums, deductibles, or copayments.

Cosponsored a bill to permanently remove the income cap on premium subsidies for individually purchased health insurance, lower the share of income buyers pay toward premiums, and repeal several of the budget law's changes to public health coverage for low-income and older residents.
Cosponsored a bill to enlarge the tax credit for families with children and pay it in full to families with low or no earnings.
Cosponsored a bill to raise public pension and disability benefits and fund them by applying the program's payroll tax to the highest earnings.
